activities.label: Ready / idle
activities.evidence: Run is idle; absence of events alone does not mean asleep.

activities.label: Processing / planning
activities.evidence: Public run status reports thinking/running, or an explicit plan operation. This only indicates processing; hidden mental content is unknown.

activities.label: Reading a document
activities.evidence: Explicit read/inspect operation with a document target; not a guessed shell command.

activities.label: Searching / discovering
activities.evidence: Observed webSearch tool or explicit board search action.

activities.label: Writing new content
activities.evidence: Explicit writing/create-text command; fileChange alone only proves an edit.

activities.label: Editing content
activities.evidence: Observed fileChange item or explicit board edit action.

activities.label: Generating an image
activities.evidence: Observed imageGeneration item; image result is not displayed before it exists.

activities.label: Modifying an image
activities.evidence: Explicit image-edit tool operation and referenced target image.

activities.label: Organizing images / objects
activities.evidence: Ordered board move commands and object IDs; the scheduler must show each actual move.

activities.label: Carrying / dragging an object
activities.evidence: Board drag/move path with source, destination and object IDs.

activities.label: Resizing / cropping
activities.evidence: Board resize command and the affected bounds.

activities.label: Building Slate frames
activities.evidence: Actual frame creation/edit commands, not a claim to be making a deck.

activities.label: Preparing a presentation
activities.evidence: Observed frame order/layout/title operations grouped into a presentation task.

activities.label: Connecting a wire
activities.evidence: Wire command with both endpoint IDs and an animated route.

activities.label: Using a tool
activities.evidence: Observed commandExecution or generic connected-tool start; exact operation is unknown.

activities.label: Waiting for a tool / service
activities.evidence: Tool dispatch acknowledged and a provider/adapter explicitly reports waiting.

activities.label: Waiting for approval
activities.evidence: Actual approval request or pending approval record; never inferred from slow progress.

activities.label: Asking a person
activities.evidence: Explicit needs-input event, not punctuation mined from arbitrary commentary.

activities.label: Blocked / unresolved target
activities.evidence: Explicit unresolved dependency/target/permission result.

activities.label: Tool / run failed
activities.evidence: Failed/error status or a nonzero command exit code. Face indicates a problem, not disapproval.

activities.label: Checking the result
activities.evidence: Explicit validation/test operation or board inspection target.

activities.label: Task completed
activities.evidence: Successful turn completion or a completed, verified board task; not every tool finish.

activities.label: Speaking / public update
activities.evidence: Public agentMessage/text-delta/commentary. No inference about the message contents.

activities.label: Relaying between chats / agents
activities.evidence: Actual message route with sender, recipient and acknowledgement.

activities.label: Launching a temporary helper
activities.evidence: Observed collabAgentToolCall or explicit child spawn acknowledgement.

activities.label: Working alongside a helper
activities.evidence: Active child-task record linked to parent and a concrete board task.

activities.label: New result received
activities.evidence: Explicit new-result notification. Brief attention cue, not an inferred emotional reaction.

activities.label: Stopping safely
activities.evidence: Interrupted/cancelled run or acknowledged cancellation; no celebratory success cue.

activities.label: Retiring from the board
activities.evidence: Explicit user retirement command; no queued edits after retirement.

activities.label: Retired
activities.evidence: Confirmed retired lifecycle state; hidden on board, restorable from Advanced settings.

activities.label: Returning to the board
activities.evidence: Explicit user restore command; retains identity and history, does not auto-resume old writes.

activities.label: Disconnected
activities.evidence: Explicit provider/session offline status; inactivity is not evidence of a disconnect.

activities.label: Resting / paused
activities.evidence: Explicit pause or a declared UI idle threshold; a decorative presentation state, not an inferred mental state.
